caption: The scope at the top of the screen determines which workspace's tables you can see.
where filters, summarize aggregates, render charts it — all in one pipeline
code:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where Name == "POST /checkout"
| summarize AvgDuration = avg(DurationMs),
            Count = count()
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| render timechart

caption: Any query's result can become a chart in the results pane, no rewrite required.
